notes.title: NEW UPDATE IS LIVE!!
notes.content:
EDIT: [strike]We will be posting a quick patch today/tomorrow that will add an options menu so you can actually quit the game. (We forgot we turned it off until we rewrote it to fit the new inventory system as well)[/strike]
Edit of the Edit:  FIXED!
 [strike]The new build posted now has a quick work around to exit game. Right Option button opens the menu, grab whichever door you want to use and pull right trigger, then verify by pulling again.
This is not perfect, it is buggy and we are working on it but wanted a quick way to end game. 
1) if grabbed and put back the rotation is off
2) if grabbed and put back/dropped the exit option seems to stop working
(We will have these fixed shortly so be sure to only grab and use if you want to quit) [/strike]
Remember, it only saves game on level change! so if you do all of lvl3 you MUST leave that level (back to lvl2) for it to save or all that progress is lost.



Please sign out of Steam and back in to get the new updates.
(This went live 345pm Central Time, so if purchased before then please update!)

Update from Unity 5.5 to Unity 2017.2
Complete Rewrite of the inventory operations
Use right track pad left/right to cycle through inventory
Tutorial now has actual instructions!
Added a map to start game and the jeep is to continue
Better post processing (more vibrant colors, better shadows!)
Added Steam cloud saving
Torch now runs out of fuel
Added 2 full oil cans for the torch (find them!). Just grab and use on torch to 100% refuel
Added another puzzle on lvl2
Refuel small amount of torch oil lighting braziers (Use wisely!)
Added matches to light torch if not close to lit brazier to relight it (Left trigger will auto use a match if you have one)

notes.title: Upcoming Stuff, the list!
notes.content:
So I was able to build and played from start to finish, went well.
We have a list of 5 things we need to look at but not a 1 kept us from finishing the game!
However, the items we need to look at did detract from the playthrough and ultimate goal of gathering all the treasure.

So anyway..

[list]
    [*]Update from Unity 5.5 to Unity 2017.2
    [*]Complete Rewrite of the inventory operations
    [*]Use right track pad left/right to cycle through inventory
    [*]Tutorial now has actual instructions!
    [*]Added a map to start game and the jeep is to continue

And on the backside of things we removed old code/scripts still hangin around, removed some debug actions that we still had activated, and a few other things to hopefully speed it up.
We are still working on Vulkan and single pass integration and also making a working menu options screen (currently it opens but there are no options)

notes.title: Vive Update complete but not live...
notes.content:
We have engine issues, it is a known Unity bug and on build it crashes the game shortly aftter play.
Please be patient, at this time we do have the game updated and are working with the Unity community to get this resolved.

(These happen on build version):
unity exception thrown at 0x00007FF8E3A278FE (mono.dll)
unity Allocation of 78 bytes at 00000000064B4240

EDIT: We have managed to get a build going that doesn't crash howeer we are still getting 37 red errors, but we are fairly certain we can resolve those in the next day or 2.
Issue was a 'corrupt' shader that didn't like Unity 2017.2, which is fixed, now we have 1 more isseu that is causing all those other errors but it is the same script having issues with our objectpool. 

EDIT Dos:
We have only 1 more issue to resolve and then Tutorial, start, lvl1 and lvl2 will be totally working and then we just need to test lvl3 and the maze, for some reason 1 interaction isn't working so right now you can't get the diamonds (in the build not released yet so we will fix it first) but I wanted to keep everyone updated. 

RIFT players, we will need a few extra days, the player actually starts below ground and we need to figure out why but other than that it should work the same as the Vive.

notes.title: Update on the Update!
notes.content:
OK...
The scenes look fantastic, the shadows are so much better. 
However...
We decided to upgrade ALL assets to Unity 2017 instead of just the main project and fixing the scripts to work so this broke a couple things.

We are close to solving the issues, only have 4 now that we can see.

1) The particle shaders for the sand storm do NOT like Unity 2017 so had to be reduced to almost non existant for now
2) The Inventory and options button stopped working (easy fix we hope)
3) Teleport movement stopped working, not even a laser pointer (will not release it until this is fixed at least)
4) The highlight shader is a little....off...we can disable the non working parts if needed.

once we get these we will release and really would like you all to check back in the game to see the difference!

notes.title: Early Access no more!
notes.content:
[h1] WE ARE LIVE[/h1]
For those who already own it, You MUST quit and restart to get the update, the executable filename has changed so it will not work otherwise.
The game is stable, and fully playable from start to finish! (We are still tweaking and adjusting things for a better user experience though!)

PLEASE, PLEASE let us know of any issues and give a chance to fix them before posting a negative review!
We are here and working hard updating and making little changes to improve game play!

THERE IS 'WALKING' IN THIS GAME AT TIMES!!
Teleport movement is only allowed on the little brown strips on the floor.
No strips, no teleport. This was a design decision, we want you to explore and also not pass by puzzles or events. This was easier than trying to enable/disable teleport system as needed.

(I only mention since someone commented about how teleport is random and not working...this movement method is also mentioned in the first pop up box after the scene loads from the gas station setting)

Turning, had some mention of wanting snap turning.
Sorry, again, we decided if you needed to turn in this game you had to get up and actually turn around. This is ROOM SCALE not sit in a chair (though, I play seated, in my swiveling chair it works fine). If we wanted seated we would have made turning an option, but since you can stand up and physically turn and get a little more immersed in 'real life' then we want you to experience that.

The game page clearly says under PLAY AREA "room scale/standing".

Save game only saves on scene changes, it will load you to where you were when you changed levels. so if you want to save progress on level 1, you have to change to the outside or the second level down to get it to save, or else, if you close and restart you will have to pick up items again. (levels are not so big that we need random saves or multiple save slots)

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
We know there are still a few issues and we are working on them.
Mainly the Jeep from the outside area to the pyramid interaction, select NEW GAME please...
The BirdGod does not fly correctly
The load game does not work

Now what DOES work?

1) Torch fuel system, you WILL run out, be sure to light braziers and turn the torch off to conserve fuel (Left Trigger). you need a lit brazier to relight the torch!
Each brazier will replenish a small amount of fuel only once.
2) The birdgod now looks like a real bird statue and will fly (eventually)
3) The mummy now appears to steal your treasure! (HINT: after you take the coins, leave the room and return...what has changed...)


Currently levels 3 and Maze are still blocked, once a little closer to release we will open them up (we want the save/load to work properly before opening those levels).

notes.title: Been a long week!
notes.content:
We have figured out the last of the logic for level 3 and are applying it now.
We modified a room to make it smaller (non-VR version room had purpose that big, in VR it was just a pain to navigate).

Added more high lighting effects in the other levels, and another color.
(High light only works after you pick up the torch for now)

Green = inventory item, placve it in your chest
Blue = Scene item (can look at and examine)
Purple = item interacts with another item or scene object

Hope you are enjoying this game so far. We are really trying ot get level 3 and the maze completed so you can have a full long exploration of an ancient tomb!

notes.title: New Update Posted!
notes.content:
This update addresses the UI still.
We now made it so items will now highlight when in the light of the torch!
Blue are just scene items you can read or use trigger to examine.
Yellow(green) highlighted items can be put into your inventory and are either treasure or needed to solve a puzzle.
Also be sure to place the torch close to things to get the UI to react and pop up!
Just like a real explorer! Can't read things without the light being close! 
You will notice many of the UI boxes are now smaller, this is also intentional, we want you to explore and get up close to everything to 'see' it!

Remember to reach out and pull the trigger on just about everything to see if there are more hints or item descriptions!

Level 3 is progressing nicely, we got 99% of the logic worked out and it is looking good. We will post an open beta very soon with everything but the UI working correctly.

notes.title: Finally!! (Sign out and in to get update!!)
notes.content:
Problem resolved!
You can now change scenes with items (and the torch) and not get stuck in an endless loop of scene changes and still have all your items!

Options have been added (but do not work as of yet, shouldn't be too long before we have those implemented)

NEW INVENTORY SETUP!!

use the RIGHT menu button (above the track pad) to open it.
Place your hand INSIDE and  then grip to place items inside.

To remove an item, just point at the icon displayed on the lid of the chest (it will start pulsing) then reach in and use grip to remove it!

The chest will only open if there is enough room so if yuo are looking at a wall and are too close it will not work.

There have been many script changes but those are behind the scenes that are not noticed.  

We also messed with the torch collidor a bit so some UI descriptions might not appear to work, some are based on proximity to the light of the torch so palce the torch closer to the item and see if that works. We are aware this is not a perfect system and are attempting to refine it.

Sorry for the delay!

There have been many script changes but those are behind the scenes that are not noticed.  

We also messed with the torch collidor a bit so some UI descriptions might not appear to work, some are based on proximity to the light of the torch so palce the torch closer to the item and see if that works. We are aware this is not a perfect system and are attempting to refine it.

Sorry for the delay!

notes.title: UPDATE UPDATE UPDATE...
notes.content:
Yes, it's that time, sign off and back in to get the latest patch!
We do apologize, we did not expect such a game breaking patch to our systems. We hope that this installment is worth your time.
Please report any issues to us! We want to fix them!

First off, what still needs plenty of work:

CONTROLS:
Left touchpad is walking as normal 
Left grip to pick up torch
Left Wrist is inventory (for now, opened by moving right controller near it)
Right touchpad TELEPORT
Right grip to pick up everything else (place over inventory it will shrink then grip to place it in)
Right trigger to USE items on each other or items in the world. 
Right trigger to move the text box UI story along

Secondly, NEW STUFF:
1) New start scene!
2) A short story told on the pillars
3) Teleport movement (some spots are blocked on purpose, we want you to explore)
4) Opened Level 2
5) The Mummy appears (but does nothing yet! hahaha)
6) Pit trap now accessible

Third, things not working perfectly:
  
The UI is still off, we are testing a new UI on the start scene, and it is looking better but we are not done with it

Inventory is not perfect but it does work for now, the little transparent ball on the right controller you see is what we use to select the item in inventory, we left in as a guide to help you select items to remove them

The Mummy just appears and idles but has no logic yet.

There are still a few spots you can escape from the world when teleporting.


In the works:

1) Rift compatibility
2) New inventory setup
3) Options (in game, graphics etc)
4) Save games!
5) Of Course the full release at some point (Just an FYI, it is complete in nonVR form, so we will not be early access forever!)

notes.title: Friday Patch...rather Saturday
notes.content:
We broke the number 1 rule of development...
Never promise something for a certain day!

It seems our fears were realized. (But we hope to release late tonight or no later than tomorrow afternoon)
[list]
[*]We almost have the bugs worked out enough for a playable level 2 however after fixing what broke from the software updates we ran into issues with our inventory system (the temporary one) and other than walking around it is not properly playable right now.

[*]We did implement the [b]teleport system[/b], which seems to work OK, however you will not be able to teleport in rooms (we want you to walk around explore. It is room scale play!) 

[*]We also changed the background and text for the dialogue/description UI to be totally readable and a little nod to nostalgia....

[*]New Start scene, not complete but will leave it in to give you an idea of the direction of the game
[/list]

We apologize for the delay. As always please be kind in any reviews and remember it is early access, we listen to our players and do our best to fix everything pointed out!

notes.title: Coming Up!! (Maybe...)
notes.content:
[h1]Well, we broke everything! (for a while!)[/h1] 

Yes, that's right, we updated some of our 3rd party VR code libraries (including SteamVR) and it broke all our custom scripts and other asset linking/logic. But have no fear, we are working hard to fix them and have most of them all repaired already. Updating tech is always a sour issue.

So, what we have working at the moment is..
Ready for this?

[list]
[*]TELEPORT movement. But don't get too excited, we limited that to only the hallways because we want you to explore the rooms! So left hand is walking and right hand is used for teleport.

[*]We changed the start scene, really not functional yet but so much better!

[*]Opened the rest of level 2! 
[/list]
We have a few things left to do before public release and were set back by the update issues so we might have to postpone a day, we will try not to, but please be patient, we want to make you happy!

I will update you tomorrow on the progress! (Hopefully release)

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
[h1](Be sure to sign out and back in to get this update!)[/h1]
We worked all day and made a few changes. We were excited to see the positive comments and want you to enjoy our first VR title!
(Some issues are tough, as mentioned this is a non-VR game we converted to VR so not as simple as starting from the ground up as VR)

1) Removed the Remaining treasures box from the eye and placed it on the inventory window (also spelled REMAINING correctly this time). (Haven't gotten to fix the behavior of the UI yet, so sometimes it will stay on by itself, once it's worked it will turn on and off along with the inventory, expect that in a future update, probably next weekend).

2) Removed the pink box (room area)!

3) Added something special to level 1.....

4) Hid controller after picking up the torch.

5) Adjusted the items to hopefully go into inventory easier (seems only the staff is a real pain to get right the first time). (More tweaks will come in later.)

6) Walking is now touchpad PRESS not touch. (will add a slider to change speed later, and possibly and option to decide between touch and press).

7) Text descriptions now pop up immediately instead of letter by letter!

[h1]Coming next week...[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]The rest of level 2 ![/b] 
This includes the pit to figure out how to cross, the hallway of the gods, another couple rooms to explore!

[*][b]Still working on the push back issue when trying to reach over a table etc...[/b]
[*][b]We are working on a new start scene which I think will be pretty cool...trying for next week but no promises on that one.[/b]
[*][b]Deciding on the skin for inventory.[/b]
[*][b]Texturing levels 3 and the maze .[/b]
[*][b]Adding more scene items and interactable items.[/b]

[*][b]Rift support[/b] (but no promise as to when, though. But we didn't forget about you guys!)

[/list]

notes.title: Sorry Forgot! (Controls explained)
notes.content:
[h1]Forgot to actually explain the controls a little bit (until I get a better in-game description setup)[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Left controller GRIP[/b] picks up the torch (You do not have to hold the buttons).

[*][b]The area around the tip of The Torch[/b] examines objects when the torch is lit. 

[*][b]Outside the pyramid, looking at objects, while near them examines objects.[/b] But currently that's only true if you are not carrying the torch. We might extend this to allow "Freelook" when you are on a well lit area, but are limited to the torch while in the dark.

[*][b]The Inventory menu is on the left hand[/b] (We are working on skinning it). The inventory becomes visible when the right controller gets close to it, in the same way it becomes invisible when the right controller moves away. As a side note, items which can be stored will scale down while near the inventory to make it easier for you to see what you are doing.

[*][b]Right hand grip[/b] picks up or drops objects.

[*][b]Right hand grip[/b] also stores or takes out items from the inventory. To store an item, put it close to the inventory's face (while it's visible) and press the grip. To remove an item select an occupied slot in the inventory and press the grip (only if you are not holding another item). (only some objects and treasures can be put in the inventory).

[*][b]Track pad on both hands[/b] moves you on touch (you don't have to click it) and you go in the direction you are facing, there's no need to point the controller.

[*][b]Right hand trigger[/b] allows you to USE objects on other objects/treasures (if the item allows it) or USE items in the world (ie: generally on objects you can't pick up, like walls, columns or the cart).
[/list]

[i]*Updated January 8 2017*[/i]

As a side note, items which can be stored will scale down while near the inventory to make it easier for you to see what you are doing.
[b]Right hand grip[/b] picks up or drops objects.

[b]Right hand grip[/b] also stores or takes out items from the inventory. To store an item, put it close to the inventory's face (while it's visible) and press the grip. To remove an item select an occupied slot in the inventory and press the grip (only if you are not holding another item). (only some objects and treasures can be put in the inventory).
[b]Track pad on both hands[/b] moves you on touch (you don't have to click it) and you go in the direction you are facing, there's no need to point the controller.

[b]Right hand trigger[/b] allows you to USE objects on other objects/treasures (if the item allows it) or USE items in the world (ie: generally on objects you can't pick up, like walls, columns or the cart).
